description: This file is a migration script for a PHP-based HRM system (OrangeHRM). It defines a class that manages database schema updates and data insertion for internationalization-related tables ('ohrm_i18n_*'), including creating tables, adding foreign keys, and inserting localization data.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A database migration class for setting up internationalization tables and permissions for version 4.6.0 of the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs database schema updates and data insertions, including creating tables, foreign keys, unique constraints, and inserting localization data.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version identifier for this migration, '4.6'.

methods.name: readlanguageYaml
methods.description: Reads and parses a YAML file containing language data.

methods.name: insertLanguages
methods.description: Inserts language data into the 'ohrm_i18n_language' table.

methods.name: insertGroups
methods.description: Inserts group data into the 'ohrm_i18n_group' table.
